blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A new resolution which reiterates the need for a congressional investigation on the large-scale dredging operations in Zambales has been filed by Mamamayang Liberal party-list Rep. Leila de Lima, saying that the ecosystem damage continues if this issue remains unchecked. In a statement, de Lima said she filed House Resolution No. 1601
